root_cause.zero-admin-race: The sole-admin block lived only in the leave modal (selectLeaveModalState over the last-known adminPubkeys); leaveGroupImpl never re-read admins at execution, so two co-admins both passing the stale modal check could both depart and leave zero admins.
root_cause.invite-label: selectableContactsForGroup keyed only on group.memberPubkeys, which already includes an invitee at the MLS commit; a not-yet-confirmed invitee therefore got 'already_member'. The confirmedPubkeys (Pending badge) signal computed in groups.tsx was never passed to the picker.

fix.zero-admin-race: New pure shouldAbortLeaveAsSoleAdmin + resolveLeaveModalState in leaveEligibility.ts. leaveGroupImpl re-reads mlsGroup.groupData.adminPubkeys in its own try/catch right after the member read and before sends/tombstone/purge; returns false on abort. LeaveGroupButton stays on the page and shows the existing lastAdminLeaveBlocked notice when leaveGroup resolves false.
fix.invite-label: selectableContactsForGroup takes optional confirmedPubkeys and yields 'invite_pending' for unconfirmed members; getInviteReasonText + new i18n key inviteReasonInvitePending (en/de); InviteMemberModal takes a confirmedPubkeys prop, groups.tsx passes it when non-empty.

verification_answers.VQ-2: YES. The admin read is its own try/catch placed after the member read and before the first send/tombstone/purge. Tests cover a throwing groupData getter and a throwing member read with groupData naming the leaver sole admin.
